title: Angels of the Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Angels of the Bible Crossword
description: Solve an angels Bible crossword: Michael and Gabriel, the seraphims of Isaiah, the cherubims at Eden. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Scripture's angels are rarely the soft-focus kind. They stand at the gate of Eden with a flaming sword, wrestle a man until daybreak, shut the mouths of lions, and open prison doors. Angels of the Bible gathers them across both testaments — the two named archangels, the seraphims crying holy in Isaiah's vision, the host over Bethlehem.

The KJV plurals are their own small lesson: cherubims and seraphims, both with the s. Get those right and the crossings fall into place. The closing verse is the promise about angels having charge over you.

clues.text: Archangel who contended about the body of Moses
Angel sent to Mary at Nazareth
Each had six wings, in Isaiah’s vision (KJV plural)
Placed at the east of Eden with a flaming sword (KJV plural)

verseText: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
